description: Proprietor started new commercial trading business with cash capital ₹5,00,000
narration: Being cash capital introduced by proprietor to commence trading business
explanation: Increases Cash Asset (Debit Cash A/c ₹5,00,000) and creates Internal Capital Liability (Credit Capital A/c ₹5,00,000).

description: Opened a new commercial current account with State Bank of India by depositing cash ₹2,00,000
narration: Being cash deposited into SBI Bank current account
explanation: Contra entry: Debit Bank Asset (SBI Bank A/c ₹2,00,000), Credit Cash Asset (Cash A/c ₹2,00,000).

description: Purchased office wooden furniture for shop setup paid by bank cheque ₹45,000
narration: Being office furniture purchased for shop setup via bank cheque
explanation: Increases Fixed Asset (Debit Furniture A/c ₹45,000) and decreases Bank Asset (Credit SBI Bank A/c ₹45,000).

description: Purchased inventory trading goods on credit from vendor Bengal Electricals ₹80,000
narration: Being goods purchased on credit as per Supplier Tax Invoice #BE-402
explanation: Increases Purchase Expense (Debit Purchases A/c ₹80,000) and creates Sundry Creditor Liability (Credit Bengal Electricals A/c ₹80,000).

description: Sold trading goods for cash to retail customer ₹35,000
narration: Being cash sales executed as per Retail Cash Memo #101
explanation: Increases Cash Asset (Debit Cash A/c ₹35,000) and increases Sales Revenue (Credit Sales A/c ₹35,000).

description: Purchased office printing paper, registers, and pens for cash ₹2,800
narration: Being office printing and stationery items purchased for cash
explanation: Nominal Rule: Debit Printing & Stationery Expense A/c ₹2,800, Credit Cash A/c ₹2,800.

description: Paid monthly shop rent ₹12,000 to landlord by SBI Bank cheque
narration: Being monthly shop rent paid via bank cheque
explanation: Nominal Rule: Debit Rent Expense A/c ₹12,000, Credit SBI Bank A/c ₹12,000.

description: Deposited cash ₹15,000 into SBI Bank current account
narration: Being cash deposited into bank current account
explanation: Contra Entry: Debit SBI Bank A/c ₹15,000, Credit Cash A/c ₹15,000.

description: Sold trading merchandise goods for cash ₹28,000 to customer
narration: Being cash sales executed as per Cash Memo #108
explanation: Increases Cash Asset (Debit Cash A/c ₹28,000) and increases Sales Revenue (Credit Sales A/c ₹28,000).

description: Paid staff salary ₹22,000 in cash for April 2026
narration: Being staff salary for April paid in cash
explanation: Nominal Rule: Debit Salary Expense A/c ₹22,000, Credit Cash A/c ₹22,000.
